book.name: Hibru
book.title: Saveeŋ To Timbooda Ila To Yes Hibrua Hibru—Hebrews

content: Yesu iza tiina ilib pa Mose

Yam toŋvetaz, poiŋ to ndug sambam igham gham anim Maaron tamtoghon toni patabuaŋa wa. Tovenen matamim iŋgal pooi pa Yesu. Iit taghur ila toni, ve tavovotia varu taghaze ye mbaŋooŋa to Maaron, ve daba tau to watooŋrau. Hib 2:17, 4:14+, 12:2

Uraat to Maaron ighuri ila nima, ye ighami itaghon katin Maaron ŋgar toni, inimale muuŋ Mose igham katin uraat to Maaron ighuri ila nima, ve iŋgin poian Maaron ruum toni. Ruum tonowen, nene yes Israela to Maaron igham di tinim le. Nam 12:7

Iit tawatag: Ighaze ŋgeu eta irei ruum poia eta, nene pale tamtoghon tipait ruum tonenen. Eemoghon ŋgeu to irei ruum, ghoro tipaiti kat. Nene raraate inimale Mose ve Yesu. Yesu iza ilib pa Mose pasa, Mose ye inimale ruum moghon. Ve Yesu, ye inimale ŋgeu to irei ruum.
Ruum to naol ne, tamtoghon tirei di. Eemoghon Maaron to ighur mbeb tisob tivot. Mbnp 1:1+
Mose, ye mbesooŋa to Maaron ve igham katin uraat naol pa ruum to Maaron itaghon Maaron ŋgar toni. Ve ye isavia mbeb pida to muri Maaron ivotia di tivot tighazooŋ.

Eemoghon Krisi, ye Maaron Natu to iŋgin poian ruum to Maaron itaghon Maaron ŋgar toni. Ve ighaze tamatughez maau, ve takis ghurla toit tuŋia, ve taghur mataad pa nepooŋ poia to Maaron pale igham pait, ve tiniid iza pani, nene pale tapatooŋ tauud taghaze iit ruum to Maaron. 1Kor 3:16; 2Kor 6:16; Hib 6:11
Tamtoghon to tizorzoor Maaron aliŋa, ye irau igham di atedi izi maau
Tovenen alooŋ saveeŋ to Avuvu Patabuaŋ ivotia pait. Ighaze:

content.text: “Aazne, ighaze yam alooŋ Maaron aliŋa, apoon lolomim pani malep.
Ve atoov Maaron ve azoora inimale muuŋ nditimbumim tighami izi ndug balim malep.
Ndaman tamoot ru to tineep izi ndug balim, you nagham uraat tintina ila lolodi, ve tighita pa taudi matadi.
Eemoghon tighur inim tiou maau, ve tinoknok tovaaŋ ghou.
Tauto tigham ghou ateg yabyab kat, ve nasaav padi naghaze:
‘Ndiran tonowen lolodi pa titaghon ataam tiou maau.
Moghon moghon tiyel pa ataam tiou.’
Tauto nasaav ariaŋa padi toman ateg yabyab, ve napariaaŋ saveeŋ tiou naghaze:
‘Onoon kat. Ndug to naghaze atedi izi pani, yes irau tilooŋ tila pani maau. Maau le maau kat!’” Nam 14:21+; Mbo 95:7+; Mt 4:7

content: Tovenen yam toŋvetaz, apatum gham: Pa vene ŋgar samia ighereb tiam eta, ghoro ipul ghurla toni, ve ipul muri pa Maaron mata yaryaara.

Ndag to naol ne, yam irau awapalotin gham pa ŋgar poia. Pa vene, ŋgar samia itombaan tiam eta, ghoro ipoon lolo, ve irau ighilaal Maaron muul maau. Uraat to palotiiŋ tonenen, asakia ila sawa ite paam malep. Aghami to aazne. 1Tes 5:11,14; Hib 10:24+

Sawa to taghur ila to Krisi muuŋ, taghur ila toni ariaŋa. Iit irau tikis ghurla toit tuŋia tovene le sawa toit isob. Leso tapatooŋ tauud taghaze iit itaad ite Krisi ve talup tomani. 1Kor 15:2; Hib 6:11, 10:35; Syg 2:25
Saveeŋa, Maaron isavia muuŋ wa. Ighaze:

content.text: “Aazne, ighaze yam alooŋ Maaron aliŋa, apoon lolomim pani animale nditimbumim to muuŋ tizoor Maaron aliŋa izi ndug balim ne malep.” Mbo 95:7+; Hib 4:7

content: Laak, sei masin to tilooŋ Maaron aliŋa ve tizoora? Nene yes ival tiina to Israel to Mose imuuŋ padi ve igham di tipul Isip ve tila.

Ve sei masin to Maaron ate yabyab padi irau ndaman tamoot ru? Nene yes Israela to tinoknok ghamuuŋ sosor. Tauto Maaron irab di timatmaat ve patudi tiwaghengheen izi ndug balim. Nam 14:1-35; 1Kor 10:1+
Ve sei masin to Maaron isaav ariaŋa padi, ve ipariaaŋ saveeŋ toni ighaze ndug to ye ighaze atedi izi pani, yes irau tilooŋ tila maau? Saveeŋ tonenen iŋarua yes to tizoor ye aliŋa.
Saveeŋ naol tonene ipatooŋ ghiit ighaze yes Israela tighur ila maau, tauto yes irau tilooŋ tila ndug to Maaron ighaze atedi izi pani ne maau. Yo 3:36; Hib 4:6
